newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND PULL AWAY TO RECORD WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND PULL AWAY TO RECORD WIN.

text.p: England recorded their highest score over Scotland in 114 Calcutta Cup meetings on Saturday as they opened their Five Nations campaign with a 41-13 victory at Twickenham.
The home side scored four tries, including three in a five-minute spell late in the second half, which ensured a record eighth successive triumph over the Scots.

Captain Phil de Glanville, his predecessor Will Carling and scrum-half Andy Gomarsall all struck in quick succession between the 68th and 73rd minutes in a virtual repeat of Wales's dramatic try-burst in their win over Scotland a fortnight ago.
Fly-half Paul Grayson added 21 points with the boot to further erase the memory of a poor English first-half display.
